title: Add 'Import device progress' option in Settings
description: Add an option in Settings page for users who previously declined migration to import their device progress later. Acts as an 'undo' for users who declined by mistake or changed their mind.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Section appears in Settings only if localStorage has anonymous progress
Section appears only if current user's ID is in songscript_migration_declined_by array
Shows summary: 'Device progress available: X words, Y songs'
Clicking button opens same confirmation modal from US-057
On successful import: remove userId from declined array, clear localStorage progress
Verify in browser: option appears after declining, works correctly
acceptanceCriteria.notes: Requires email login - code implementation complete

completionNotes: Created Import Device Progress section in settings.tsx
